non-identifying-artifact-title-strings: The page title is a leftover like 'Untitled Document', a 'TODO' placeholder, or a filename such as 'report.html', which is technically present but tells the user nothing about the page.
title-describes-secondary-not-primary-to: On a busy page the title names a sidebar, ad, or banner instead of what the page is actually about, so users picking from open tabs or search results are misled.
stale-in-family-wrong-instance-title: The title is on-topic but names the wrong specific item, like last month's date or the previous product, usually left over from copying a template or a sibling page.
title-too-generic-to-distinguish-page-in: An inner page's title is only the site name or a shared label every page uses, so users cannot tell this page apart from its siblings in tabs or history.
title-loses-meaning-out-of-context: A title like 'Step 2' or 'Chapter 3' is clear while on the page but meaningless when seen alone in a tab list or search results, with no surrounding context.
